postBodyFormat: JSON object with named fields (server-generated bash example)
audioContainer: not known before first generated file; Audio component format unset
sampleRate: not advertised; must inspect the first actual file

authentication.conclusion: No login required for the observed read-only endpoints; inference authentication not tested

integration.wordbank: Existing generateBatch can reuse its manifest/validation/resume handling with an explicit Gradio fetchImpl adapter and actual LAN endpoint; raw endpoint is not OpenAI-compatible. Adapter must map fields, wait same event_id, download FileData URL, transcode/return actual MP3 bytes.
integration.story: Existing generateScenarioAudio explicitly permits only loopback hostnames; do not spoof localhost/proxy around that guard. An explicit user-authorized LAN Gradio path/allowlist adaptation is needed, or a clearly separate offline binding helper reusing planScenarioAudio+generateBatch.
integration.profile: Must use actual Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice model and Serena in a new profile/hash; do not label new audio as existing MLX 0.6B.

risks: Returned FileData URLs should be pinned to the authorized host; no arbitrary remote fetch.
A lost event stream must resume GET using the saved event_id, not blindly POST a duplicate generation.
Status text must be inspected for model/generation failure even when HTTP is 200.
